checks.reference_match: Compare the actual source artwork and reference video. Recognizable colors alone do not establish the same character or painted style.
checks.eyes: Original small paired navy oval eyes: size, spacing, shape, placement and restrained gaze. A paired natural blink is allowed; unintended asymmetric morphs fail.
checks.flame_and_limbs: Reference flame silhouette, irregular painted layers, soft wispy taper, mouthless face and compact limbs. Check for a thick extruded rim, bulbous mask, rigid spear tip, elongated limbs or extra features.
checks.framing_and_props: Both planned start/end crops, full character silhouette, camera stability, required prop count and attachments. For this escalator establish both opposing rails and returns.
checks.contacts_and_action: Supported feet and hands, correct weight transfer, one planned action per beat, no skating, floating, extra steps, bobbing or repeated gestures.
checks.mechanical_direction: Inspect consecutive real frames. Confirm the described travel direction and rigid part connections. Do not infer direction from arrows or the prompt.
checks.object_continuity: Track the SAME physical object. Its marker must not jump, multiply, recolor or fade to fake a disappearance.
checks.start_end_states: The actual first/last footage frames match the user-approved stills and the required resulting pose/mechanism state.
checks.performance_and_timing: Restrained lantern-reference acting, eye/body cues, Narrator eyeline when applicable, action onset and ending hold. Use real timestamps.
checks.clean_footage: No unintended text, logos, props, narrator on screen, audio or other generation artifacts. Inspect all frames, not only the endpoints.

review_rules: A technical probe or contact-sheet extraction is preparation, never a visual approval.
The user must see and explicitly approve BOTH first and last stills before video generation. The generator cannot approve them on the user's behalf.
A dedicated reviewer inspects actual evidence independently of generation. Every required check needs pass, fail or uncertain with evidence.
Fail, uncertain, missing evidence, missing user frame approval or a changed input blocks production approval.
Reviewing a clip does not authorize another paid generation. Preserve rejected takes.

style.decision: User requested: basically copy how the lantern video looked. This is the primary appearance and motion reference.
style.character: Painted storybook flame including a wispy tapering tip; original small matched oval eyes and compact limbs.
style.motion_direction: Use the actual lantern clip as the reference for gentle movement and brief holds; no independent eye-shape acting.

composition_rules.coordinates: Percentages refer to the 9:16 picture, with x measured from the left and y from the top. They are layout guides for stills, not exact animation coordinates.
composition_rules.captions: Reserve x=10–84%, y=80–87% as the caption target; keep important action above y=76%. Validate against the actual platform controls at phone size.
composition_rules.background: Use the lantern artwork's hand-painted storybook finish and visible grain for a simplified mall in cream and muted teal. Paint Sol with the same surface treatment and lighting as his surroundings.
composition_rules.continuity: Follow the same orange-edged tread through the generated scenes. Use previous approved generated frames for consistency; no computed route is required.
composition_rules.performance: Match the lantern video's small, deliberate performance and brief held poses. Use whole-face turns and a small body lean to direct attention, retaining both original oval eyes. A cued natural blink closes both eyes together. Keep limbs compact. Let the wispy flame tip trail slightly after a turn, then settle into its reference silhouette. Preserve the painted grain throughout the movement.
composition_rules.mechanical_readability: The generated clip must clearly show the narrated movement and correct contacts. Simplify or regenerate a scene if it is unclear.
composition_rules.narrator_eyeline: One clear upward glance toward a fixed point just above the camera when Arthur starts an exchange. Then follow the demonstrated object. Do not add repeated up/down looks within a single explanation. On the later Exactly, look up and hold the happy ending.
composition_rules.escalator_handrails: One continuous moving handrail on each of the two opposing balustrades. Establish both sides clearly in the exit view; keep each upper return fully visible and attached. Close cutaways may crop the established rail system deliberately.
